tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Finds AI tools in the Best AI Things directory for a job or by name, e.g. "remove background noise from podcasts" or "Cursor". Returns up to 10, best match first, each with its listing link.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: The full Best AI Things listing for one tool: what it does, pricing and plans, platforms, API, MCP server, license, and common questions, with its listing link.

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: AI tools in the directory that do similar work to the one named, best match first, each with its listing link.

tools.name: browse_category
tools.description: The newest AI tools in one directory category, each with its listing link.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every directory category with its slug, how many tools it has, and its page.
